title: Ukraine War Widens to Poland, the Baltic and Libya: What It Means
description_html:
The war in Ukraine is widening. Poland says three Russian objects entered its airspace, NATO promises to defend every inch of its territory, a Russian cargo ship was struck in the Baltic and a Russian warship at Benghazi, Libya, was hit. We cover what is claimed and confirmed, the reactions in Europe, Asia and the Gulf, what it means for India, and our honest read of the pattern. Claims by the parties could not be independently verified.

Listen on Spotify and watch on YouTube: Global Meridian with Bikesh Roy.
